integrity: The exact eighteen-facet complex is reconstructed from the published facet orbit and group generators. Integral homology is proved by unimodular Smith reduction; two cocycles certify exact coordinates; all graph triangles and all \(9!\) vertex permutations are exhausted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the regular nine-vertex torus triangulation and simplicial edge length. The certified basis of \(H_1(K;\mathbb Z)\) is not canonical, and the result does not compare metric or stable systoles.
title: The nine triangular systoles of the regular nine-vertex torus form three homology directions
